name: Oumagatoki ~Kaidan Romance~
source:
Suzue Shizuka seems like your average high school girl….except that she’s the descendant of a great water spirit. She has no family so she spends most of her time floating around the school pool even though she hates swimming and water. Because of her blood, she has a ton of power inside of her and unless she lets loose by getting into fights with other spirits at the school, she comes down with a fever and her powers go out of control. Typically she and her good friend Hisoka run around causing trouble and annoying the student council president and teachers. The school they attend is an average school with humans attending the day classes. At night however, it’s the “Witching Hour” where all the spirits come out and “play school” despite some of them being over thousands of years old.

[From [url=http://breadmasterlee.com/2012/04/21/otome-game-review-oumagatoki-kaidan-romance/]Hinano's post[/url]]
translation:
涼江靜看起來只是個普通高中女生……唯一不同的是，她繼承了強大水靈的血脈。靜沒有家人，雖然討厭游泳和水，卻大半時間都在學校的泳池裡漂著。她繼承的這股力量實在太強大；如果不與學校裡的其他妖怪打架、定期宣洩力量，她就會發燒並徹底失控。

平日裡，靜總與好友式部密四處惹事，給學生會長和老師添麻煩。她們就讀的學校白天十分普通，人類學生照常上課；到了夜晚，這裡卻會迎來「逢魔時刻」，所有妖怪紛紛現身，模仿人類「上學」，其中一些甚至已經活了數千年。

[內容取自[url=http://breadmasterlee.com/2012/04/21/otome-game-review-oumagatoki-kaidan-romance/]Hinano的文章[/url]]
